Senses.Explanation: Literally, the empty eon. The term occurs 838 times in 206 allowlisted texts, most often in 'before the empty eon' or 'before the empty eon was over,' language for before heaven and earth were divided or before the world was established. The records make it public-interview vocabulary: Dongshan is asked about 'oneself before the empty eon,' asks who lives in the empty-eon house with no people, and later collections ask about the affair before the empty eon. Verses call its road broad and idle or say that nobody knows the far-off empty eon. A discourse itself expands the phrase as 'before heaven and earth were divided.' It is a stock Chan time-beyond-cosmic-time formula.
Senses.Note: One referent across compounds and questions: an imagined eon before the formed world. Different answers and poetic predicates are deployments, not separate senses.

Occurrences.Kwic: 僧問。如何是空劫已前自己。師曰。白馬入蘆華。官人問。有人修行否。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: The Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Dongshan Wuben of Junzhou (筠州洞山悟本禪師語錄), in Dongshan Liangjie's question-and-answer record. An unnamed monk is the exact questioner who asks, ‘what is oneself before the empty eon?’; Dongshan Liangjie answers, ‘a white horse enters the reed flowers.’ The line, expanded context, section header, book title, TEI header, and parallel-passage search do not give the monk a personal name.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師問疎山。空劫無人家。是甚麼人住處。疎山云。不識。師云。人還有意旨也無。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: The Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Dongshan Liangjie of Ruizhou (瑞州洞山良价禪師語錄). Dongshan Liangjie is the exact questioner who asks Shushan Kuangren, ‘the empty eon has no human household—whose dwelling place is it?’ Shushan answers that he does not know; Dongshan then asks whether that person has an import.

Occurrences.Kwic: 梁山觀禪師。僧問：如何是空劫已前事？師云：擊動乾坤鼓，時人聽不聞。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 禪林類聚, Liangshan Yuanguan case. The exact headword-bearing speaker is an unnamed questioning monk: he asks what the matter before the empty aeon is, and Liangshan answers with the unheard drum. All six rungs leave the monk unnamed.

Occurrences.Kwic: 空劫已前，乾坤未剖，凝然一片，非聖非凡，不涉熏脩，豈從外有？洎乎世界安立，
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 開福道寧禪師語錄: complete-case exact-turn review identifies Kaifu Daoning as the actor for this occurrence.

Occurrences.Kwic: 滿眼覰不見，滿耳聽不聞。空劫已前事，分明舉似君。須記取，逢人莫錯舉。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: The Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yuelin Shiguan (月林師觀禪師語錄), in Yuelin Shiguan's hall address while residing at Chengtian Nengren Chan Monastery in Pingjiang. Yuelin is the exact speaker who says that the affair before the empty eon is plainly presented and warns the assembly not to present it wrongly.
